# sspi_role_binding (Resource)

Grants SSPI roles to a remote (LDAP) user or remote (LDAP) group. Local users cannot be granted roles through this API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sspi_role_binding" "admins" {
  entity_name = "Administrators"
  user_type   = "REMOTE_GROUP"
  roles       = ["ENTERPRISE_ADMIN"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_name` (String) The remote user or group being granted roles (for example `Administrators` or `sspuser1@corp.example.com`). Changing this forces a new role binding.
- `roles` (Set of String) The roles to grant: `ENTERPRISE_ADMIN`, `AUDITOR`, and/or `SUPPORT_BUNDLE_COLLECTOR`. On update this set fully replaces the entity's existing roles.
- `user_type` (String) The kind of entity: `REMOTE_USER` or `REMOTE_GROUP`. Changing this forces a new role binding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the role binding.

## Import

Import is supported using the role binding id (as returned by `GET /sspi/iam/role-bindings`):

```shell
terraform import sspi_role_binding.admins <binding-id>
```
